summary: State Bank of India (SBI) is recruiting Specialist Cadre Officers for the posts of Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) on a regular basis. A total of 60 vacancies are available for eligible Indian citizens. The selection process includes an online written test followed by a personal interview.
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in any discipline from a Government recognized University or Institution.

For Manager (Security), applicants must be an Officer not below the rank of Major in the Indian Army (or equivalent) with a minimum of 10 years of commissioned service, OR a Deputy Commandant in Para-military forces with a minimum of 10 years of service.

For Deputy Manager (Security), applicants must be an Officer not below the rank of Captain in the Indian Army (or equivalent) with a minimum of 5 years of commissioned service, OR an Assistant Commandant in Para-military forces with a minimum of 5 years of service.
Age limit is 25 to 40 years as on October 31, 2026, with relaxations for reserved categories as per Government of India guidelines.
Applicants must possess medical fitness in SHAPE-1 or an equivalent medical category as on the date of advertisement release.
how_to_apply_steps: Candidates are required to register online through the link available on the SBI website.
Scan and upload a recent photograph and signature as per specified guidelines.
Fill in the application form carefully, saving information if needed.
Submit the completed application and proceed to pay the application fee online using Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI.
Upload all required documents including ID proof, age proof, caste certificate, educational qualifications, experience certificate, and medical documents in PDF format.
Take a printout of the system-generated online application form and e-receipt for future reference.
